rationale: The complete raw production Android fingerprint exactly matches the installed v1.0.2 APK runtime, without normalization or a runtime override. expo-application 58.1.2 was already included through expo-notifications; only its direct dependency declaration was added. The app changes are JavaScript, JS-loaded skins/effects and version reporting. EAS Update is technically recommended. However the existing guard rejects dependency metadata/lockfile edits before resolving the fingerprint and computes APK. That policy mismatch remains a publication blocker; this review does not bypass the guard, change CI, bump APK versions or publish.
evidence: The publishedBaseline helper verified stable APK v1.0.2, source 710bd2e10b4eb8aa16378486f3cb3517770ac878, successful master build run 40502268634, archived EAS build d51d8be5-d5a1-4f8e-897e-71fd22381369, production channel, version 1.0.2, versionCode 3 and runtime 4a7adc844a392bfaead47665719d0291b9f3da58. git confirms the APK source belongs to origin/master.

Compared the complete APK-to-source file list and master-to-source diff. app.json, app.config.js, eas.json, config/, modules/, native plugins, launcher/splash assets, native hooks and ignore files are unchanged from the APK. Character PNGs are imported by JavaScript in skin-artwork.ts; SkinEffects uses existing React Native Animated and react-native-svg.
The only package and lockfile changes versus the APK are the root expo-application ~58.1.2 declaration. Its resolved lock entry remains unchanged at 58.1.2; expo-notifications already depends on it.

SDK-local runtimeversion:resolve --platform android --workflow managed on the reviewed production source returned raw runtime 4a7adc844a392bfaead47665719d0291b9f3da58. The complete fingerprint equals the published APK with no normalization. fingerprintSources includes expoAutolinkingConfig:android with expo-application 58.1.2.

review-context returns mode=apk, compatible=false, normalizedRuntime=null, exemptions=[] with reasons: Package metadata, dependencies, or non-deployment scripts changed; Native/build input changed: package-lock.json. The current classifier stops before checking the exact raw fingerprint.

Existing review-check and production plan require no blockers and equality between recommendation and deterministic mode. APK mode would also fail check-release because app/package 1.0.2, versionCode 3 and the published v1.0.2 tag remain unchanged. No version or classification exception was silently selected.

Inspected check.yml, cloud-build.yml, publish-release.yml, publish-web.yml, eas.json, app.config.js, deployment.mjs, deployment-review.mjs, deployment-history.mjs, check-release.mjs and release-candidate.mjs. A resolved update route would preserve the installed APK runtime, verify returned source/runtime, promote the same-source web and record a revision Release while retaining APK Latest. Publication is currently blocked before these steps.

Change-summary baseline is successful production update v1.0.2-r1, source ffb6ba236cd8a3ecf283750cfe4ba9babf2072e4. Compatibility baseline remains v1.0.2. This candidate includes PR #29 skins/effects, PR #27 release summaries and PR #31 user version reporting, plus the final black-cat home artwork/placement already present in develop.

User version reporting uses one row per auth.uid(), SECURITY INVOKER, own-row RLS, completed-admission checks and server timestamps. Migration 20261029025831 is already applied; transactional SQL checks rolled back all test observations. App code remains unpublished.
